column3: “by a powerful hand” renders “by strength of hand,” and “the house of slavery” renders “a house of slaves.”
“from year to year” renders “from days to days.”
“With a powerful hand” renders “by strength of hand.”
“phylacteries on your forehead” renders “marks (totaphot) between your eyes.”
“change their minds” renders “regret”; “even though it was near” renders “for it was near.”
“the Red Sea” renders “Sea of Reeds,” and “in martial array” renders “arrayed for battle.”
“solemnly swear” and “surely” render emphatic doubled verbs; “take care of you” renders “visit you.”
“He did not take away” makes the LORD the subject; the Hebrew can be read “it (the pillar) did not depart.”
